name: Albany
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Albany, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Albany, CA: Winter on Solano Avenue on December 6 with a kids zone, music and Santa, plus free Santa photos on three December weekends.
lede: Albany does Christmas on Solano Avenue, where the Solano Avenue Association fills the street with a kids zone, music and Santa, and keeps free Santa photos going on three December weekends.
celebrates: Albany's Christmas season centers on Solano Avenue, the one-mile shopping street it shares with Berkeley. The Solano Avenue Association runs a seasonal program there with live music, activities, specials from local businesses and a Kids Fun Zone that it says always draws a crowd. Its winter weekend is Winter on Solano, held on a Sunday in early December, and its Santa on Solano photo days run across three December weekends. The association says its public events are family friendly, free and wheelchair accessible, and that Solano Avenue stays open to cars.
lastyear: The Solano Avenue Association describes its Santa on Solano program as a local tradition since 2007, so families have been lining up for free photos with Santa on the avenue for many Decembers. The association's winter program has long paired that with live music and a kids zone, and in recent years it has also invited a limited number of outside vendors, including nonprofit agencies, artisans and makers, to join the shops along the street.
facts: Solano Avenue's seasonal events span the one-mile stretch from The Alameda to San Pablo Avenue, which means the street bridges two cities, Berkeley and Albany. The Solano Avenue Association says its Santa on Solano photo spot is the only free photo opportunity with Saint Nicholas in the region, and that Santa is pet friendly, unlike the malls. It has run Santa on Solano since 2007.
trains: Albany has no train station of its own. The closest rail stops are in neighboring towns: BART's El Cerrito Plaza and North Berkeley stations, and the Amtrak Capitol Corridor station at 700 University Avenue in Berkeley. For holiday train rides, the Tilden Steam Train in the Berkeley hills runs on weekends and over the holiday break, and Niles Canyon Railway runs its Train of Lights from Sunol and Fremont. San Francisco's cable cars run all season.

Local bands and singers play at Peralta Park on Solano during the winter program.
kidfact: Solano Avenue is one street in two cities. Its seasonal events run a mile from The Alameda to San Pablo Avenue, across Berkeley and Albany.
faq: What Christmas events does Albany have for kids?

Winter on Solano Avenue on Sunday, December 6, 2026 has a Kids Fun Zone, live music and Santa on Solano. Santa on Solano also runs on three December weekends with free photos. Both are presented by the Solano Avenue Association and are free.
Where can kids meet Santa in Albany?

Santa on Solano is at 1758 Solano Avenue, near Colusa, which is on the Berkeley side of the avenue. It runs noon to 3 pm on Saturdays and Sundays on three December weekends, and the association says photos are free.
Is Solano Avenue closed to cars for Winter on Solano?
No. The Solano Avenue Association says Solano Avenue stays open to vehicle traffic, unlike its summer Stroll, and that the program runs rain or shine.
Can I bring my dog to see Santa on Solano?
Yes. The Solano Avenue Association says Santa is pet friendly, unlike the malls. It asks only that there be no fleas, and families bring their own camera for photos.
How do I get to Albany without a car?
Take BART to El Cerrito Plaza or North Berkeley, or ride Amtrak's Capitol Corridor to the Berkeley station, and continue by local bus to Solano Avenue. Check AC Transit for current routes.
